title: 第28章 她是我朋友
novel_title: 觉醒阴阳神功：分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
陈阳被桃夭一路护送，很快就抵达了梅兰山庄。

    车子稳稳停下，桃夭率先下车，为陈阳打开车门，恭敬说：“陈少，请。”

    陈阳点了点头，走下车，跟着桃夭朝着山庄深处走去。

    梅兰山庄内部环境清幽，草木葱郁，小路两旁种满了名贵的花草，空气中弥漫着淡淡的花香。

    桃夭领着陈阳，径直走入北边一间别墅，在一个房间前，停下脚步，对着房门轻声说：“梅姐，陈少来了。”

    房间内，立刻传来柳醉梅带着几分难受的声音：“快……快进来。”

    桃夭伸手推开房门，侧身做出一个“请”的手势，对着陈阳说：“陈少，请进。”

    陈阳迈步走进房间，目光瞬间被床上的身影吸引。

    柳醉梅躺在床上，身着一身丝质的粉色睡裙，裙摆轻薄，勾勒出她曼妙玲珑的身段，肌肤白皙如雪，在柔和的灯光下泛着细腻的光泽。

    长发散落在枕头上，眉眼间满是难以掩饰的痛苦，原本明艳动人的脸蛋此刻苍白无血色。

    眉头紧紧蹙起，嘴唇被咬得微微泛红，额头上渗出细密的汗珠，纵然状态不佳，依旧难掩那份性感妩媚。

    陈阳看着她这副模样，心中莫名一热，小腹当即传来一阵发胀的不适感，眼神下意识在她身上停留了几秒，才勉强收回心神。

    柳醉梅看到陈阳，眼中瞬间闪过一丝激动，挣扎着想要坐起来，却被小腹的剧痛牵制，只能躺回床上。

    她声音虚弱又急切地喊道：“陈高人，你快来给我治治，我好痛，实在受不了了。”

    她一边说着，一边用一只手紧紧捂着小腹，身体微微蜷缩着。

    陈阳反应过来，连忙快步上前，没有丝毫犹豫，一只手轻轻越过她的睡裙，缓缓伸放到她的光滑扁平小腹上。

    随即运转体内的阴阳神功，掌心瞬间产生一股微弱的吸力，缓缓吸缩着她小腹内的寒气。

    站在门口的桃夭看到这一幕，脸色变得有些古怪。

    但想起昨晚的经历，她并没有上前阻止，只是安静地站在原地，垂眸不语，装作什么都没看见。

    治疗过程中，柳醉梅脸上的痛苦神色渐渐缓解，眉头慢慢舒展，苍白的脸颊也泛起了一丝血色，呼吸也变得平稳了许多，原本紧绷的身体也渐渐放松下来。
content_en:
Chen Yang was escorted all the way by Taoyao and soon arrived at Meilan Villa.

The car stopped steadily, and Taoyao got out of the car first, opened the door for Chen Yang, and said respectfully: "Master Chen, please."

Chen Yang nodded, got out of the car, and followed Tao Yao towards the depths of the villa.

The interior environment of Meilan Villa is quiet and lush, with precious flowers and plants planted on both sides of the path, and the air is filled with a faint floral fragrance.

Tao Yao led Chen Yang straight into a villa in the north. He stopped in front of a room and whispered to the door: "Sister Mei, Master Chen is here."

In the room, Liu Zuimei's somewhat uncomfortable voice was immediately heard: "Quickly...come in quickly."

Tao Yao stretched out her hand to open the door, turned sideways and made a "please" gesture, and said to Chen Yang: "Mr. Chen, please come in."

Chen Yang stepped into the room and his eyes were instantly attracted to the figure on the bed.

Liu Zuimei was lying on the bed, wearing a silk pink nightgown with a thin skirt that outlined her graceful and exquisite figure. Her skin was as white as snow, glowing with a delicate luster under the soft light.

Her long hair was scattered on the pillow, her brows and eyes were filled with unconcealable pain, and her originally bright and charming face was now pale and bloodless.

His brows were furrowed tightly, his lips were bitten slightly red, and fine beads of sweat oozed from his forehead. Even though he was in a bad state, he still couldn't hide his sexy charm.

When Chen Yang looked at her like this, his heart felt inexplicably hot, and he immediately felt a bloated discomfort in his lower abdomen. His eyes subconsciously stayed on her body for a few seconds before he reluctantly recovered his mind.

When Liu Zuimei saw Chen Yang, a flash of excitement flashed in her eyes. She struggled to sit up, but was restrained by the severe pain in her lower abdomen and could only lie back on the bed.

She shouted in a weak and urgent voice: "Master Chen, please come and treat me quickly. I'm in so much pain that I really can't stand it anymore."

As she spoke, she held her belly tightly with one hand and curled up slightly.

Chen Yang reacted and quickly stepped forward. Without any hesitation, he gently crossed his hand over her nightgown and slowly placed it on her smooth and flat belly.

Then she activated the yin and yang magic in her body, and a weak suction force instantly appeared in her palm, slowly sucking in the cold air in her lower abdomen.

Taoyao, who was standing at the door, looked a little weird when she saw this scene.

But remembering her experience last night, she didn't step forward to stop him. She just stood there quietly, lowering her eyes and saying nothing, pretending not to see anything.

During the treatment process, the painful look on Liu Zuimei's face gradually eased, her brows slowly relaxed, her pale cheeks also turned a trace of blood, her breathing became much smoother, and her originally tense body gradually relaxed.
